LESSON: PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should you speak accurately? 2. How can you speak without unnecessar y pauses?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to oral presentations such as poems and topical issues from audio recordings with words containing the sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ and digraph ‘gh’ and pick out the words with sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ in ‘gh’ from the text,

2. repeat words with target sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ and digraph ‘gh’ from the teacher or an audio recording accurately,

3. speak expressively on a familiar text within a specified time, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to oral presentations such as poems and topical issues from audio recordings with words containing the sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ and digraph ‘gh’ and pick out the words with sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ in ‘gh’ from the text,
2. repeat words with target sounds /s/ /z/ /h/ /f/ and digraph ‘gh’ from the teacher or an audio recording accurately,
3. speak expressively on a familiar text within a specified time, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is enhanced when the learner recites poems related to the theme at an

appropriate pace.

• Self-efficacy: It is developed as the learner develops confidence in speaking when they repeat oral texts without

hesitation and at a reasonable speed.

Value:

Peace: It is enhanced as the learner respects self and others when they repeat words with target sounds inaccurately.
